answer: Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 3 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the sable check. Bindings are kept in hollow, verified in relic, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history therefore fails the binding, which means it has to store and read state per alias. Repeating the trick 19 times costs 9 separate deposits and 11 separate proofs of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
